notes.title: Small update + News about new game!
notes.notes:
Hello, friends!

I want to tell you about the last update and the next chapter of the game.
The update includes small improvements such as UI and blood splats on the surfaces when bullet penetrates the body.

About the game... you can find it here https://store.steampowered.com/app/1408260
Hentai vs Evil includes more maps, more customization, updated UI, more enemies and new mission

It was no sense to update the current game as it was more meme-game. Add the new game to your whishlist, if you were waiting for the more content. The games both are cheap so I hope you will not get angry about my decision :)
